name: BRAS CR3 (chamber music hall), demo with measured T30
_note: Demo config: BRAS scene CR3, geometry and fitted absorption / scattering from the BRAS database v3 (L. Aspöck et al. 2020, https://doi.org/10.14279/depositonce-6726.3, CC BY-SA 4.0; this file is a derived work under the same licence). S_amp is at the BRAS loudspeaker position LS1; the PA pair B_L / B_R is an invented position for the demo (not part of BRAS). Receivers MP1-MP5 are the BRAS measurement positions. Measured T30 / EDT for calibration: bras_cr3_measured_T30.csv (LS2 rows are role=check). Materials are uncalibrated (BRAS 'fitted' estimates).
